items.title: 科学家发现脖子的进化并不是我们想象的那样
items.title_orig: Scientists discover that necks didn't evolve for the reason we thought
items.summary: 科学家们发现，近 3.8 亿年前第一批冒险登上陆地的动物有着令人惊讶的僵硬脖子，推翻了长期以来的进化论。脖子的出现并不是为了帮助动物转动头部，而是作为解剖学变化的一部分而出现的。
items.summary_orig: Scientists have discovered that the first animals to venture onto land nearly 380 million years ago had surprisingly stiff necks, overturning a long-standing theory about evolution. Rather than evolving to help animals turn their heads, necks may have emerged as part of the anatomical changes that allowed them to move using their front limbs.

items.summary_orig: A textual diff of two formal policies flags every cosmetic change and hides the one that alters behavior. items.title: 检测 Amazon SageMaker HyperPod 上的静默数据损坏并从中恢复
items.title_orig: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: 无声数据损坏是一种 GPU 故障，它会返回错误但看似合理的数字，而且没有任何错误，从而悄悄地毒害分布式训练。本文向 PyTorch DDP 循环添加了三项检查来检测它，定位 Amazon SageMaker HyperPod 上的故障节点，并将该节点交给自动恢复以供代表
items.summary_orig: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. This post adds three checks to a PyTorch DDP loop to detect it, localize the faulty node on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and hand the node to automatic recovery for replacement.

items.summary_orig: The Angular team has introduced ngp, a compiler preprocessor that rewrites the analysis stage in Rust using Oxc. Adoption is expected in an Angular 22 minor release; production builds should stay on ngc until then.

items.title: 为什么衰老的恒星的光度突然下降
items.title_orig: Why Aging Stars Suffer A Sudden Luminosity Dip
items.summary: 当像太阳这样的低质量恒星老化时，它们会离开主序并跟随红巨星分支。当它们上升到这个分支时，它们的亮度稳步增加。但路径中存在一种称为 RGB 亮度凹凸的小问题，它们的亮度会突然下降。
items.summary_orig: When low-mass stars like our Sun age, they leave the main sequence and follow the Red Giant Branch. As they ascend this branch, their luminosity steadily increases. But there's a sort of hiccup in the path called the RGB luminosity bump, where their luminosity suddenly dips.

items.summary: 我维护 Nino，一个用于 C# 的源代码生成的二进制序列化器。我一直致力于的一项优化是反序列化为现有的 .NET SortedList。有线格式交错键和值，而 SortedList 将它们存储在单独的数组中。如果目的地已经有房间，我们可以检查一下吗？
items.summary_orig: I maintain Nino, a source-generated binary serializer for C#. One optimization I’ve been working on is deserializing into an existing .NET SortedList. The wire format interleaves keys and values, while SortedList stores them in separate arrays. If the destination already has room, can we check the order and fill both arrays in one pass?
